    n = int(input[0])

    forbidden_products = set(map(int, input[2:])) if n > 0 else set()

    sequence = []
    prefix_product = 1
    used_numbers = set()

    for i in range(m):
        if i not in forbidden_products and i not in used_numbers:
            new_prefix_product = (prefix_product * i) % m
            if new_prefix_product not in forbidden_products:
                sequence.append(i)
                prefix_product = new_prefix_product
                used_numbers.add(i)

    print(len(sequence))
    print(' '.join(map(str, sequence)))
